# Claude Code 2.1.280 — diretório e memória

Resumo verificado em 2026-09-22 contra os docs oficiais; detalhes nas fontes.

Key facts for the babel-os builder (topic: .claude directory, CLAUDE.md, `@imports,` rules, auto memory, context window):

1. Project scope files: CLAUDE.md (or .claude/CLAUDE.md), CLAUDE.local.md (gitignore manually), .mcp.json at project ROOT (not inside .claude/), .claude/settings.json, .claude/settings.local.json, .claude/rules/*.md (recursive), .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md, .claude/commands/*.md (skill wins on same name), .claude/agents/*.md, .claude/workflows/*.js, .claude/agent-memory/<agent>/MEMORY.md (memory: project), .claude/agent-memory-local/<agent>/ (memory: local).
2. User scope: ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md, ~/.claude/settings.json, ~/.claude/rules/, ~/.claude/projects/<project>/memory/MEMORY.md (auto memory), ~/.claude/projects/<project>/<session>.jsonl (transcript), ~/.claude/history.jsonl (every prompt, never swept), ~/.claude/stats-cache.json. CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR relocates all of ~/.claude.
3. <project> = cwd path with non-alphanumerics replaced by '-': -Users-marcelomaximos-Desktop-babel-os (exists; memory/ subfolder now created). Names >200 chars are truncated + hash. In a git repo the path derives from the repo root; babel-os is not a git repo today. CLAUDE_CODE_PROJECT_DIR_NAME only works with CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR (v2.1.234+).
4. CLAUDE.md load order: Managed (/Library/Application Support/ClaudeCode/CLAUDE.md on macOS) -> ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md -> ./CLAUDE.md or ./.claude/CLAUDE.md -> ./CLAUDE.local.md. All are CONCATENATED, not merged/overridden; root-down ordering; nested CLAUDE.md load lazily when Claude reads files in that subdirectory.
5. CLAUDE.md is delivered as a user message after the system prompt, not inside it. Only --append-system-prompt or claude --agent <name> reach system-prompt level.
6. Root/user CLAUDE.md are read once at session start; mid-session edits do NOT apply until /clear, /compact or restart. Nested CLAUDE.md and paths: rules load when first triggered. Block-level HTML comments are stripped (outside code blocks). Target <200 lines; files >4 MiB are skipped entirely.
7. `@imports:` `@path` (relative to the importing file), max depth 4 hops, skipped inside code spans/fences, load at launch (no context savings). Imports outside cwd from project files trigger a one-time approval dialog; declining disables them permanently for that project.
8. .claude/rules/*.md: only frontmatter key read is `paths` (YAML list or comma string; brace expansion budget 1,000 patterns / 4 MiB). Broken YAML => rule loads as unscoped. Unscoped rules load at launch with same priority as .claude/CLAUDE.md and are re-injected after /compact; paths: rules are summarized away by compaction until a matching file is read again. Exclude with claudeMdExcludes (array of absolute-path globs, any settings layer, arrays merge).
9. AGENTS.md (v2.1.277+) is read only when no CLAUDE.md/.claude/CLAUDE.md/CLAUDE.local.md exists in cwd or above; irrelevant for babel-os. `pluginConfigs["agents-md@builtin"].options.instructionFiles` values: claude-md-or-agents-md (default), claude-md-and-agents-md, claude-md, managed-only (managed-only still loads auto memory).
10. Auto memory: on by default; four types in the topic file frontmatter `type`: user, feedback, project, reference. MEMORY.md is an index; only its first 200 lines or 25 KB load every session; topic files load on demand. Over-limit writes succeed but return an error asking to rewrite the index. `modified` (ISO 8601) is auto-added only if frontmatter already exists (v2.1.214+). Subagents do not see main auto memory (except fork).
11. Toggles: autoMemoryEnabled (boolean, any scope; /memory writes it to user settings); CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AUTO_MEMORY=1 disables, =0 forces ON even under --bare or autoMemoryEnabled:false; env var wins over the key for one session in either direction (settings-reference.md). --bare and safe mode disable it. autoMemoryDirectory (string, absolute or ~/) from any scope; from project/local settings it is honored only under workspace trust and ignored under permissions.blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories.
12. Subagent memory: frontmatter `memory: user|project|local` -> ~/.claude/agent-memory/<name>/, .claude/agent-memory/<name>/, .claude/agent-memory-local/<name>/; first 200 lines/25KB of that MEMORY.md go in the subagent system prompt; Read/Write/Edit auto-enabled; no effect when auto memory is off.
13. Context cost table: CLAUDE.md every request; skills descriptions at start, body when used; MCP names only until used; hooks cost zero unless they return context. After /compact: system prompt, output style, root CLAUDE.md, unscoped rules, auto memory, plan, git snapshot re-injected; paths: rules and nested CLAUDE.md wait for a trigger; up to 5 recent files (>5,000 tokens become references); invoked skill bodies max 5,000/skill, 25,000 total; skill description list is NOT re-injected.
14. HOOK OUTPUT RULE (corrected): for most events (PostToolUse, PreToolUse, Stop...) plain stdout on exit 0 goes to the debug log only and only JSON hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext enters context. EXCEPTIONS: SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, UserPromptExpansion, PostModelSwitch add plain-text stdout to Claude's context. Stderr on exit 0 never reaches Claude. additionalContext/systemMessage/initialUserMessage and plain stdout each capped at 10,000 chars (saved to file + 2,000-char preview; Claude not told to read it).
15. SessionStart: matchers startup, resume, clear, compact, fork; only type command and mcp_tool; runs in background but Claude's first response waits; input `source` plus optional model, agent_type, session_title; output fields additionalContext, initialUserMessage (-p only), sessionTitle (startup/resume/fork), watchPaths, reloadSkills; CLAUDE_ENV_FILE for exports. Re-inject the substrate after compaction with matcher "compact" and a plain `cat memoria/INDICE.md` (official example uses echo).
16. InstructionsLoaded: fires on every CLAUDE.md/rule load; input file_path, memory_type (User|Project|Local|Managed), load_reason (session_start|nested_traversal|path_glob_match|include|compact), globs (path_glob_match only), trigger_file_path, parent_file_path; matcher against load_reason; async, no decision, JSON output discarded. Does not fire for AGENTS.md read via the setting.
17. ConfigChange: fires on settings/skill file changes; input source (user_settings|project_settings|local_settings|policy_settings|skills) and file_path; can block with exit 2 or {"decision":"block"} except policy_settings; use it to log the organism's own config evolution.
18. Transcripts <session>.jsonl: format is internal and changes between versions; DO NOT parse. Use claude -p --output-format json|stream-json, claude -p --resume <id> --output-format json ... | jq -r '.result', the transcript_path field (hooks/statusline) and a SessionEnd hook to archive. history.jsonl line format is not documented either. The organism must log its own structured records into memoria/eventos.jsonl via hooks.
19. Retention: cleanupPeriodDays default 30 (min 1; 0 fails) sweeps projects/<project>/*.jsonl, subagents/, tool-results/, file-history/, debug/ etc.; memory/, history.jsonl, stats-cache.json, agent-memory/ are NOT swept. claude project purge <path> deletes everything for a project (use --dry-run first). All files are plaintext.
20. Data-killing flags: CLAUDE_CODE_SKIP_PROMPT_HISTORY=1 (no transcripts/history in any mode), --no-session-persistence (-p only), --bare / CLAUDE_CODE_SIMPLE=1 (no sweep, no auto memory, no hooks/skills/CLAUDE.md discovery). Never set these for Marcelo.
21. Subagent files: .claude/agents/ is hot-watched but the FIRST creation of the agents directory mid-session needs a restart; files silently skipped without name, with --- not on line 1, name starting with - or containing :, name without description, or bad YAML; validate with claude plugin validate .claude/agents (v2.1.233+); >15,000 tokens of combined descriptions warns; omitClaudeMd v2.1.271+; subagent transcripts at ~/.claude/projects/{project}/{sessionId}/subagents/agent-{agentId}.jsonl.
22. Alternative persona design: claude --agent gabriel or {"agent":"gabriel"} in .claude/settings.json makes the agent file's body REPLACE the Claude Code system prompt (CLAUDE.md and project memory still load); initialPrompt is auto-submitted as first user turn; CLI flag beats the setting. Recommended: keep persona in CLAUDE.md first, offer --agent as an optional experiment.
23. Prompt caching: project context layer (CLAUDE.md, auto memory, unscoped rules) changes only at session start, /clear, /compact; editing CLAUDE.md keeps the cache but does not apply; TTL 5m default / 1h on subscription; statusline exposes current_usage.cache_read_input_tokens and cache_creation_input_tokens.
24. Settings precedence: managed > CLI/--settings > .claude/settings.local.json > .claude/settings.json > ~/.claude/settings.json; arrays merge, scalars take the most specific; settings hot-reload (except model, effortLevel, modelSettings), CLAUDE.md does not.
25. Recommended babel-os layout: CLAUDE.md (<200 lines, persona + `@memoria/INDICE.md`), .claude/{settings.json, rules/, skills/, agents/, hooks/, workflows/, agent-memory/}, memoria/{INDICE.md, perfil-marcelo.md, decisoes.md, eventos.jsonl, refinado/}, scripts/ (python3), dashboard/index.html. Never import eventos.jsonl or refinado/* into CLAUDE.md. Vital rules (memoria.md, portugues.md) must have no paths: so they survive /compact.
